Hi Sarah / Contracts team,

Thanks again for moving this forward. Attached are the latest clean copy of the MSA (Crescent_MSA_clean_copy_v3.pdf) and the Order Form/SLAs (OrderForm_CRS-SLA.xlsx). Before we create the DocuSign envelope we need a quick inventory so we can set the signer order and the authentication method. Specifically: 

- Confirm the names, titles, and email addresses for the signers who will be on the MSA and which signers (if any) are required on the Order Form.
- Tell us whether Crescent prefers sequential routing or parallel signing. For SLA-sensitive deals we usually do sequential (customer -> Redwood) to ensure your signers see final terms.
- Any additional signer authority docs (POA, board resolution) to attach? If so, please send or confirm they can be appended.

We also plan to: 
- Add the SignerAuthority_Roster.csv to the envelope for audit purposes.
- Request embedded signing for your in-house counsel if you prefer, otherwise standard email signing is fine.

If you can confirm the inventory and routing by EOD today, we can create the envelope and share the DocuSign link for approval.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the context. Quick answers: 

1) Authentication: For a GC signing an MSA with a delegation doc, email authentication is acceptable. If Crescent prefers extra assurance, we can enable SMS code verification (DocuSign ID check) — there will be a small admin overhead. Recommend email auth only unless the dollar threshold or internal red flags.

2) Final delivery: please configure the envelope to: 
   - Produce a single consolidated PDF containing the fully executed MSA + Order Form + SignerAuthority_Roster.csv (appended as a PDF stub)
   - Save the executed PDF to our Drive folder (link in metadata) and mark the HubSpot deal CR S-2027-0582 with the DocuSign envelope ID.

3) Routing/order: Confirm sequential routing (Crescent GC -> Crescent CFO on Order Form -> Redwood VP legal or signatory). We (Redwood) should be last to sign so we have final executed doc.

4) Witnessing / Notary: Not required. If Crescent later requests notarization we can provide notarized copies but not part of the initial flow.

Once you receive the SignerAuthority_Roster.csv from Sarah, create the envelope and share the preview link with me and Karthik for a quick check before sending live. 

Laura Bennett
Head of Contracts 
Redwood Inference
